|sellprice = 200 |description = {{Description|Tea Set}} |showheader = n }} The '''Tea Set''' is a piece of decor obtained as a gift from a Secret Gift-Giver at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. Any adult other than [[Clint]], [[Evelyn]], [[Marnie]], [[Robin]], or [[Willy]] may give you a Tea Set. From Year 25 onwards, there is a 5% chance for the [[Traveling Cart]] to sell the Tea Set for {{Price|1000000}} during any season. The Tea Set can be stacked in a player's [[inventory]] or [[chest]], sold, and given as a [[Friendship#Gifts|gift]]. The Tea Set is the only item labeled as “decor” besides the craft-able floors. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Abigail,Pierre,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Jodi,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leo,Wizard,Alex,Penny,Elliott }} ==References== See Content\Data\Shops.xnb, ID "Traveler" in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.6|Can now be purchased from the Traveling Cart in Year 25+.}} {{NavboxFurniture}} [[Category:Decor]] [[Category:Furniture]] [[de:Teegeschirr]] [[es:Juego de té]] [[fr:Service à thé]] [[it:Servizio da tè]] [[ja:ティーセット]] [[ko:다기세트]] [[hu:Teás készlet]] [[pt:Conjunto de chá]] [[ru:Чайный набор]] [[tr:Çay Takımı]] [[zh:茶具]]
